NextRole autofill privacy

Updated October 30, 2026

This notice covers NextRole Application Autofill and the browser-local handoff from the NextRole website. Other NextRole features, such as optional AI services or Gmail connections, are separate and are not accessed by this extension.

Information you choose to use

You review your contact details, employment and education history, dates and application preferences in NextRole. You choose a PDF or Word resume. The website can retain that resume file and extracted text in browser storage on this device so you do not need to select it on each visit. The extension receives a copy only when you choose Save to extension and confirm in its own window.

Local storage and confirmation

The website stores extracted resume text and the reviewed profile in localStorage, and the retained PDF/Word file in IndexedDB, scoped to the website origin in this browser profile. The handoff uses browser extension messaging. It does not upload these documents to a NextRole application server. Pending transfers use temporary extension session storage; closing or cancelling the confirmation discards the pending copy. Transfer confirmations expire after ten minutes. After you confirm, the reviewed profile and resume use local extension storage restricted to trusted extension pages. They are not placed in browser cloud sync. Extension v1.4.0 can report only saved-document status, filename, timestamp and a content fingerprint to the trusted NextRole website so it can compare versions. It does not provide the website with the saved profile contents or resume file. This is local storage, not a promise of application-level encryption; protect your device and Edge profile.

Use on application pages

When you invoke the extension, it reads supported field labels and existing values on the current application page to prepare a preview. It uses your reviewed facts to suggest entries. Only fields and resume uploads you select are filled. Filling sends those values or documents to that website, which may autosave them before you submit. Review the destination and entries first. NextRole does not click Submit, accept consent, infer sensitive screening answers or bypass authentication or CAPTCHA.

Access and sharing

The extension can communicate with the exact NextRole website. The store package has no access to arbitrary websites in the background; application-page access is granted when you invoke it. There is no advertising, analytics, sale of profile data, remote-code execution, Gmail access or API key in the extension. Microsoft Edge Add-ons may separately process installation or store interactions under Microsoft's policies. Employer sites handle filled application information under their own policies.

Replace or delete your copies

In the extension, expand Saved documents and backup import, then choose Remove saved profile or Remove saved resume. Uninstalling the extension also removes its local storage. With extension v1.4.0 or later, NextRole setup can request removal of the extension copy, or both website and extension copies; removal requires confirmation in the extension’s own window. Older extension versions keep their existing popup removal controls. Website storage is separate: use Remove resume and Clear saved autofill profile in NextRole, or clear this website's browser data. Removing a local copy does not delete information already sent to an employer. Failed replacement imports preserve the previous saved documents.

Browser-only resume tools and application tracking

Jobs you manually add by pasting a supported platform link and description are saved in localStorage in this browser. They can be included in local recommendations under your existing filters for up to seven days after adding or updating them. Their availability is not verified by saving them.

The public website can compare pasted job descriptions with resume keywords, format your draft, generate Word/text downloads and open a print preview on your device. Formatting, keyword comparison, document downloads and job matching run locally. Optional Gemini tailoring is described separately below. Word pagination is not certified by these local checks. Application statuses, referral names and notes are stored in this browser. A downloaded application backup contains personal information: keep it private. Restore merges new records without replacing existing records with the same ID. There is no account or cross-device sync for these browser-only tools. Clearing website data removes the browser copies, so download a backup first if needed.

Optional on-device models and portable backups

The public website can download a semantic matching model and an optional language model from public CDNs and Hugging Face. These downloads disclose normal connection information, such as your IP address, to those hosts. Semantic matching runs on this device. The older optional local language-model code is separate from the opt-in Gemini tailoring workflow below. Model files may remain in browser cache; unload stops the worker but does not erase downloaded cache files. Remove this website’s browser data to remove its saved documents and caches; downloads remain separate.

The portable backup uses a password-derived key (PBKDF2-SHA256) and AES-GCM encryption before download. It can contain your website resume, retained file, reviewed profile, preferences and local application records. The password is not saved or recoverable. No automatic cloud transfer occurs. If you upload the encrypted file to your own drive, that provider’s policies apply. Restore replaces the listed website data after confirmation. The option to also restore the extension profile and resume is selected by default; it sends the backed-up reviewed profile and file through the local extension handoff and requires confirmation in the extension window. If cancelled or unavailable, the website remains restored and the extension keeps its previous documents. Backups without a current reviewed profile or valid resume attachment need review in Application autofill first.

The public job feed contains only configured company-careers listings, refreshed by GitHub Actions. Applicant documents and Gmail data are never placed in that feed or repository.

Optional Gemini resume tailoring

When you connect your own Gemini API key and agree to Google sharing, NextRole sends your original resume text, selected job description and any clarification answers you approve directly from your browser to Google’s Gemini API. The default model is Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. This is separate from local job matching. No shared owner key, paid fallback, grounding/search tool or NextRole AI backend is used.

The key is held only in this tab’s memory, cleared from the input after connecting, and never included in website backups, localStorage, sessionStorage, URLs or logs by NextRole. Disconnect clears the key and cached reviews. Review outputs and approved clarification answers stay in memory. Only daily usage counters and timestamps under a one-way key fingerprint are persisted locally. The app caps each browser/key at three reviews and fifteen requests per UTC day, up to five requests per review and three requests per minute, with request pacing, timeouts and no automatic retries. These are browser safeguards, not provider-wide or tamper-proof spending controls; Google quotas apply per project.

For no-charge use, use a free-tier Google project with billing disabled and check its settings in AI Studio. NextRole cannot verify billing settings or guarantee that a billing-enabled project will not charge. Google may use free-tier inputs to improve its products; read Google’s current terms before sharing personal information.

Gemini reviews the whole supplied resume and may ask up to three missing-evidence questions. You approve additions and proposed wording, summaries and ordering. Local fact checks and a second model check can reject suggestions, but they do not certify factual accuracy, employer eligibility or ATS acceptance. Your original matching resume remains unchanged. On errors, quota limits, cancellation or failed validation, no AI suggestion is automatically applied. Browser Word exports use Calibri at 11, 10.5 or 10 points and block detected overflow at the minimum size; actual Word pagination still needs checking.

Questions and support

Contact the project owner through NextRole support. Do not attach resumes, contact details or credentials to public issues.
